label: EdgeLink v11 采集
info:
EdgeLink v11 主编排流程 — Phase 4: 完整版 (7子Flow): 完整采集链路

=== v11 最终架构 ===
Config Pipeline:
  inject(2s/300s) → sf-config-manager → mqtt-out(node online) + global.edge_devices

Collection Pipeline:
  inject(1s) → fn-scheduler (读 edge_devices, triggerKind过滤)
    → fn-router (按 comType 分流)
      → MC_Protocol → sf-mc-driver → sf-data-processor
      → Modbus_TCP  → sf-modbus-driver → sf-data-processor
                        ↓
              ┌────────┼────────┐
              ↓        ↓
         mqtt-out(data)  edgelink-pg-store (npm)

Handshake Trigger:
  mqtt-in(edgelink-v11/trigger/scan/#) → fn-handshake

v11 MQTT Topic 前缀: edgelink-v11/
v11 全局变量前缀: edge_

name: ===== 1. 配置管线 (启动 + 5min刷新) =====
info: sf-config-manager: IP检测 → JWT登录 → nodeId注册 → 拉取点位 → 分组 → 筛选 → 输出配置 + MQTT上线

name: 配置就绪
===== 2. 采集管线 (1s, 协议可插拔) =====
info:
调度器 → comType分流 → MC Driver / Modbus Driver → Data Processor → MQTT数据 + PG写入

P0修正:
- triggerKind=2 过滤保留在调度器(本Flow)
- 字段平铺, 使用 id 不是 deviceId
- device-comm 仅状态变化时推入 edge_commPending
